cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. When I said the evening would flow, I meant this kitchen flood. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Water is now the dominant topic. A remarkably accurate forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said we'd need to open up. The plumbing listened first.
